CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Noah and his sons? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Noah and his sons.
   B. Say Noah and his sons has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Noah and his sons to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Noah and his sons with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of The call of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Say The call of Moses has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The call of Moses.
   C. Apply the teaching of The call of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The call of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible as a Guide? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Bible as a Guide to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say The Bible as a Guide has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Bible as a Guide with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible as a Guide.

4. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

5. Which response best shows understanding of A hand writes on the wall? (1 mark)
   A. Use A hand writes on the wall to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing A hand writes on the wall.
   C. Apply the teaching of A hand writes on the wall with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say A hand writes on the wall has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Work? (1 mark)
   A. Say Work has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Work with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Work to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Family Unity? (1 mark)
   A. Say Family Unity has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Family Unity to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Family Unity.
   D. Apply the teaching of Family Unity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of The Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Fall of Man has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Fall of Man.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

11. Which response best shows understanding of Mount Carmel Contest? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Mount Carmel Contest.
   B. Apply the teaching of Mount Carmel Contest with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Mount Carmel Contest has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Mount Carmel Contest to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Early Church 3 4.2 The Lords Supper 3 4.3 The Holy Spirit 3 4.4 Peter Miracu and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Early Church and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Lord’s Supper and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Holy Spirit 3 4.4 Peter Miraculous Rescue 3 5.0 Christian Living 5.1 Friends and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
